name: context-trim
subtitle: Audit and tighten an agent's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md
title: Context Trim
installMethods: Upload the folder as a zip in Claude apps: Customize > Skills (upload not tried by us)

permissions.files: Reads instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules) and the repository files that define commands, paths and versions. Writes instruction files only after the user approves the proposal.
permissions.shell: None. It does not run the commands it checks. Bundles no scripts.
